album: Tilly Birds unite regional fans at intimate Singapore stop of 'Through Layered Walls' tour — gig report
excerpt: Thai alt-rock favourites Tilly Birds brought a softer, more vulnerable side of their music to Singapore with the latest stop of their I'll Remember To Forget You: Through Layered Walls tour — and fans from across Southeast Asia showed up in full force for it. Held at Swee Lee Clarke Quay, the stripped-down showcase traded massive stage production for warm lighting, vinyl-lined walls, and acoustic renditions of some of the band's most beloved tracks.
